text.source: Results: county returns as published by NBC News (from the Associated Press) on Nov 9, 2026, with 95% to 99% of the expected vote counted in each county. Counts are unofficial until certified. Swing compares with the official 2022 governor county results from the Georgia Secretary of State (two-party share). Residents: Census Bureau July 1, 2025 county estimates (Vintage 2025), as published by the Georgia Department of Community Affairs. Island fragments of coastal counties are left off the map.
